title: Economic Futures Research Fund Agenda
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: Official announcement from Anthropic: Economic Futures Research Fund Agenda
body:
The Anthropic Economic Futures Research Fund has been established with a commitment of $200 million to support external research on interventions that prepare society for the economic impacts of AI. The fund aims to study programs that can make the economy more flexible and resilient, ensuring the benefits of AI are shared and minimizing harm from AI-driven disruption. This initiative is an evolution of the Economic Futures program, launched a year ago, with an updated focus on ambitious projects and large grants.

The fund will support research on interventions proposed in the Economic Policy Framework (EPF) and other open questions, with a focus on large-scale randomized control trials (RCTs) and ambitious pilots. The fundable directions include:
* Large-scale RCTs or ambitious, creative pilots
* Program evaluations that expand understanding of what shows promise and in which contexts
* Filling gaps where evidence is thin and inspiring new solutions
The fund is open to proposals that may not be captured in the outlined directions, with a focus on partnering with research organizations that share their findings publicly at key milestones.

## Why this matters
The establishment of the Anthropic Economic Futures Research Fund is significant because it acknowledges the uncertainty surrounding the economic impacts of AI and the need for empirical evidence to inform interventions. By committing $200 million to support external research, Anthropic is taking a proactive approach to addressing the potential disruption caused by AI. The fund's focus on large-scale RCTs, ambitious pilots, and program evaluations demonstrates a commitment to rigorous research and evidence-based decision-making. This approach is likely to yield valuable insights and guidance for workers, firms, and governments as they navigate the challenges and opportunities presented by AI.
